headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
key_facts: TGPWU + TADF boycotting Uber, Ola and Rapido rides from RGIA Shamshabad, effective 10 September 2026
25,000 cabs off the road at the airport on Friday, per the union
G.O.Ms.No.46 dated 9 December 2022 fixes Rs 21 per km; drivers say they receive Rs 12-15 per km
Joint Commissioner of Labour, Ranga Reddy Zone, advised the three platforms on 31 August 2026 to implement the notified fares
Union also objects to Rs 500 penalty after the free drop-off window was extended from 8 to 10-15 minutes
Union demands a stakeholder meeting and a written resolution on all pending issues
not_verified: Number of flights or passengers affected
Any response from Uber, Ola, Rapido or RGIA management
image_rights: No news photograph with clear reuse rights identified. Publishing the branded graphic with 3+3 bullets instead, per the image rule.
bullets_en: Around 25,000 app-based cabs stayed off the road at Hyderabad airport as drivers began a boycott.
Union says drivers get Rs 12-15 per km against the government-notified Rs 21 per km.
Uber, Ola and Rapido airport rides refused; union seeks talks and a written resolution.
bullets_ur: Drivers ke boycott se Hyderabad airport par taqreeban 25,000 app-based cabs band hain.
Union: Notified Rs 21 per km ke muqable drivers ko sirf Rs 12-15 per km mil rahe hain.
Uber, Ola, Rapido ki airport rides refuse; union meeting aur likhit resolution ka mutalba kar rahi hai.
